marketing.title: Grade10 — graded cards, bought and sold in one place
marketing.description: Buy graded slabs outright from the Grade10 store, or bid on the ones that only come up once. One account carries your profile, your orders, and your bids.

about.title: Grade10 — Asia’s premier trading card venture
about.description: Grade10, founded in 2023, unites Hong Kong’s thriving trading card industry and passionate collectors — a platform to connect, trade, showcase collections, discover rare finds, and explore new horizons together.

aboutFinance.title: Grade10 Finance — Card-backed liquidity
aboutFinance.description: Grade10 Finance is a planned card-backed financing desk for high-value trading card collectors, operated by Grade10 Finance Limited.

aboutVault.description: Museum-grade vaulting for trading cards, secured at Crown Fine Art with 24/7 surveillance, climate control, independent audits, and tokenized ownership on Solana. Built by Grade10, a division of MemeStrategy (HKEX: 2440).
